name: Mural 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Light display capitals with broad proportions, rising crossbars and flared serif terminals.
observed: Directly sampled characters: 35689ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVW. Printed page 190, PDF page 196. Larger impressions anchor the master; smaller sizes supply additional characters. Small 0/X/Y impressions inform the separately documented reconstructions. Additional directly traced impressions supply 1247J. Exact editions, pages, crops, scale anchors and cleanup are recorded in source/tracing.json and reference/specimen-restoration-sources.json.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: Z. Zero is rebuilt from the larger O at the observed figure width. X and Y are redrawn from tiny impressions with stroke contrast matched to larger letters. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Lowercase input aliases the capitals. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Mural; printed p. 190, one-based PDF page 196, Internet Archive leaf 196
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.
